llm_response.reason: ctmarket.org displays multiple characteristics of a scam website, including promises of unrealistic ROI (up to 80% returns), instant withdrawal, copy-trading to mirror 'professional traders', ambiguous company information, unverifiable testimonials, reference to privacy policy without clarity, excessive urgency and psychological manipulation ('we help your money grow', 'instant'), and a lack of standard payment options (crypto only). The supposed team, business history, and endorsements cannot be verified, and the structure and promises align with high-risk cryptocurrency scam tactics.
